description: This is a unit test class for testing the functionality of the FieldMapJsonHandler in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It verifies JSON parsing behaviors, including handling null input, empty JSON objects, and complex nested JSON structures.

classes.name: FieldMapJsonHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the correct parsing and handling of JSON objects within the FieldMapJsonHandler implementation.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test JSON data for use in test cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, initializing the handler and parser.

methods.name: tryToParseNullString
methods.description: Tests that parsing a null string throws a JsonParseException with a NullPointerException cause.

methods.name: parseEmptyObjectStringToEmptyMap
methods.description: Verifies that parsing an empty JSON object results in an empty map.

methods.name: parseObjectString
methods.description: Checks correct parsing of a complex nested JSON object into expected map structure.
